jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer – Entitlement Management System (EMS)

Job Title:

Senior Software Engineer – Entitlement Management System (EMS)

About us:

Accuris was formed in May 2023 through the combination of S&P Engineering Solutions (formerly part of IHS Markit) and Techstreet, bringing together over six decades of leadership in engineering standards, technical content, and workflow technology. Accuris transforms the world’s largest repository of standards and supply chain data into AI-driven insights and connected workflows — enabling engineers to work smarter, stay compliant, and innovate faster.

The Team:

The Entitlement Management System (EMS) team builds core platform services that enable products and teams across Accuris. The team owns shared capabilities including user and license management, role-based and policy-based access control, authorization and authentication, and web-based administration tools for both customers and internal users.

EMS services support high-load processing, with some services handling approximately 3 million transactions per day while maintaining high performance targets around 200 ms response times. The team values secure, scalable engineering, strong ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the full technology stack.

The Impact:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the EMS team, you will design and develop new features and enhancements across the full technology stack, with a strong emphasis on usability, performance, scalability, and security. Your work will strengthen the shared platform capabilities used across the company and help product teams deliver reliable customer experiences faster.

You will own complex components end-to-end, contribute to architecture and design decisions, and help translate business requirements into reliable, cloud-native solutions running in AWS. The role has direct impact on customers and internal teams by enabling secure access, efficient administration, and dependable entitlement workflows at scale.

Responsibilities:

Design and develop cloud-native applications and services using the Microsoft .NET stack on AWS, with a focus on ease of use, performance, scalability, and security.
Own complex components end-to-end, from requirements refinement and technical design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
Contribute to architecture, framework, and service design decisions, proposing improvements aligned with project goals, constraints, and platform standards.
Build and maintain automated tests, quality gates, CI/CD practices, and code review standards to ensure high-quality, maintainable delivery.
Support containerized and orchestrated deployments using Docker and Kubernetes, and contribute to reliable production operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
Collaborate closely with developers, IT, Product Owners, and stakeholders in Agile Scrum ceremonies, while mentoring mid-level engineers and sharing best practices.

What We’re Looking For:

Key qualifications:

Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5–7+ years of software development experience, including delivery of web-based applications and cloud-native systems.
Full-stack engineering experience with C# .NET Core, REST APIs/WebAPI, and modern front-end frameworks such as Angular or React.
Hands-on experience with microservices architecture, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Git workflows, pull requests, and code reviews.

Key soft skills:

Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across development, IT, and product teams.
Proactive, curious, and action-oriented approach to solving technical and business problems.
Commitment to engineering excellence, security, maintainability, documentation, and continuous improvement.
Good spoken and written English, B2 level or above.

Required Knowledge / Technologies:

Angular, React, JavaScript, Module Federation, and micro frontend architecture patterns.
C# .NET Core, REST API/WebAPI, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.
Docker, containerization, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Git-based version control and collaborative engineering workflows, including pull requests and code reviews.

The Location:

Poland, Gdańsk

Budget:

PLN 24,000 gross per month plus a 5% annual incentive plan.

Compensation/Benefits Information

Accuris states that the anticipated base salary / budget for this position is PLN 24,000 gross per month. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographical location as well as experience and qualifications for the role. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a 5% annual incentive plan as well as comprehensive benefits. For more information on benefits, please reach out to the recruiter assigned to the role.

Benefits include a medical package, Multisport, life insurance, internal Wellbeing program, corporate support for personal growth and career development, and provision of all necessary equipment.

About Company Statement:

We provide the world’s engineers mission-critical intelligence
, safeguarding
the technology of today and enabling the breakthroughs of tomorrow
. Accuris transforms the world’s largest repository of standards and supply chain data into AI-driven insights and connected workflows — enabling engineers to work smarter, stay compliant, and innovate faster. Behind every world-changing innovation — there’s Accuris — the most trusted intelligence platform for engineers. https://accuristech.com/

Accuris provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.description:
SENIOR .NET / AWS ENGINEER – CAMUNDA
Contract: Until the end of 2026, with a possibility to extend
Rate: €50/hour
Location: Remote(Poland or Lithuania preffered)
Language: English

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET / AWS Engineer to join a mature and highly skilled engineering squad working on a modern, distributed banking solution.
The role focuses on building and maintaining high-criticality data pipelines and enterprise applications using .NET and AWS services. A key requirement is hands-on experience with Camunda and workflow/process orchestration.

What you’ll be doing
Design and develop robust enterprise applications using .NET
Build and maintain distributed solutions leveraging AWS services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions and DynamoDB
Work with Camunda for workflow and business process orchestration
Contribute to high-criticality data pipelines with a strong focus on scalability, reliability and performance
Develop CI/CD automation using GitHub Enterprise
Work with infrastructure as code using Terraform
Troubleshoot incidents, resolve bugs and continuously improve platform stability
Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects and business analysts
Contribute to documentation and technical improvements within a self-organizing Scrum team
Help build secure and reliable solutions for a modern banking environment

What we’re looking for
3–5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong experience with .NET
Hands-on experience with Camunda – required
Solid understanding of AWS, particularly services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions and DynamoDB
Experience with GitHub Enterprise and CI/CD
Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks is a plus
Experience with Kafka or other message queue/event-streaming platforms is a plus
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Good spoken and written English

Contract details

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Location: Remote (European Time Zone), once per month in the office in Cracow

Contract Type: B2B

About Us:

ETFBOOK is a Swiss SaaS company providing data, analytics, and custom solutions in the Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) space. Founded in 2020, we aim to make global ETF data accessible, actionable, and valuable for institutional participants, including ETF issuers, index providers, fund service providers, market makers, exchanges, and buy-side institutions.
We develop a platform which offers comprehensive insights through a user-friendly web application and robust APIs, covering areas such as product analysis, fund flow tracking, performance comparisons, and liquidity assessments.

About the role:

We are seeking a Full-Stack Software Developer with interest in Frontend development to join our fully remote team spread across Europe.
You’ll join a highly skilled technology team. This team develops and maintains a cutting-edge data analytics platform using most advanced technologies to support all core business functions. You’ll be a part of a collaborative team focused on the application development. This role offers the chance to make a visible impact in a dynamic, fast-evolving field.

Responsibilities:

Develops and maintains complex end-to-end features across the latest Angular and .NET.
Designs solutions covering front-end, backend, APIs, databases, and data processing.
Leads solution design and requirements analysis for major initiatives.
Ensures end-to-end performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
Reviews code across the stack and promotes engineering standards.
Troubleshoots complex cross-system issues and supports production stability.
Mentors junior and mid-level full-stack engineers.

Requirements:

8+ years of experience in web application development.
Strong expertise in latest Angular / TypeScript and the latest .NET/ C#.
Strong understanding of front-end, backend, API and database architecture.
Experience designing and delivering complex features end-to-end.
Experience with automated testing and deployment.
Strong understanding of application performance, scalability, and code quality.
Experience with Azure and AI-assisted development tools.
Good knowledge of Azure
Works independently and takes ownership of complex tasks.
Strong communication skills in English.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Able to work effectively with Product, Data and Technology teams.
Able to review code and provide technical guidance.
Able to mentor Junior and Mid-level engineers.
Commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.

Nice to have:

Experience with data visualization.
Basics of UX/UI and ability to identify improvements.
Interest in financial markets, especially ETFs.
Experience with B2B SaaS products
Able to make and explain technical decisions.

What we offer:

100% remote work from anywhere within the European time zone.
Competitive B2B contract.
Exciting growth opportunities in a fast-paced startup.
Impactful work: help revolutionise ETF data market, currently fastest growing area of finance.
Have a real impact of developing products: your work will directly influence live projects, delivering measurable results in real-world applications.
Culture of innovation: collaborate with forward-thinking professionals in technology and finance where experimentation and creativity are encouraged.
Team- buildings events at least twice a year, hosted in various European locations.
